review.bug: Prevent permanent automatic-rejoin pause when a closing process disappears between the monitor alive check and fresh ownership verification.
review.dependencies: Based directly on published stable 1.7.7 and reuses its exact exit watches, close intents and retry reservations. Extracts existing internal ownership checks without changing conflict policy. Missing discovery defers effects; manual, policy, conflicting-ownership and failed-discovery denials remain protected. No dependency or experimental code changes.
